Walk the following input axes and find unhandled cases:
- `dayParam`: integers 0, 1, 14, 15, 999, negative, "1", " 1", "1.0", "01", "01abc", "abc", "%2F", empty string, very long string, unicode digits.
- `Program.currentDay`: 0, -1, 14, 15, NaN row in DB, NULL (not possible per schema, confirm), values clamped vs. preserved.
- `ProgramDay.contentJson`: null, empty object, missing title/focus, only title set, array (not object), unexpected types in nested fields.
- `Purchase` history: zero purchases, latest paid purchase already has ACTIVE program (don't trigger recovery), latest paid purchase has CANCELLED program, multiple paid purchases (ensure newest active wins consistently), refunded purchase, paid purchase with payment_intent missing.
- `RecoveryProfile`: present but with empty subType, present with stale castRemovedAt, missing entirely after manual deletion.
- `resolveCurrentProgramForUser` with concurrent calls: two tabs hitting `/progress` and `/api/program/current` simultaneously when no program yet exists (could the recovery transaction race or insert duplicates?).
- API route: HEAD/POST/etc methods (only GET defined; behavior on other methods).
- Page redirects: returning user with cookies but session expired mid-render, JWT with `hasPurchase=true` but DB shows refunded purchase.
- Test reliability: parallel/serial mode, leftover users from previous failed runs, time-based unique IDs colliding.

Report findings ONLY in this format:

## Edge Case Findings

### High (data corruption, auth bypass, broken paid-user UX)
- [file:line] <case> — <why unhandled> — <minimal fix>

### Medium (degraded UX, stale data, recoverable)
- ...

### Low (cosmetic, narrow corner)
- ...

If empty: "- (none)". No prose outside the findings list.
